sources.credit: Incredible India exterior aerial view, reference only.
sources.observation: The lead temple has a tall stepped tower and a low pillared hall. The stone enclosure preserves a large open court.

sources.credit: Kakatiya Heritage Trust published photograph, reference only.
sources.observation: The roof edges step along the cruciform hall. The Nandi pavilion is roofless and the dark bull remains visible above its lower walls.

limitations: The façade reliefs and bracket figures use simplified shapes. Small shrine fragments and stepped masonry are photo-based estimates. The model covers the exterior and open hall.
